turkanime.ozet: Ogata şıpsevdi diye tabir edilen insanlardandır. Günün birinde yine birine aşık olur. Fakat bu sefer aşık olduğu kişi (Takasugi) erkektir. Takasugi onun aşkına karşılık vermektedir ancak Ogata'yı alışkın olmadığı şekilde uke olmaya zorlayacak gibi görünmektedir.

jikan.title: Seikimatsu★Darling
jikan.synopsis:
Kousaku Ogata has been nursing feelings for his coworker, Youichirou Takasugi, for so long that he can no longer sleep without dreaming of him. When he finally manages to confess, he is thrilled that Takasugi feels the same way. But despite their mutual attraction, Takasugi thinks that their relationship is doomed to fail due to an unfortunate incompatibility in the bedroom. Unwilling to give up, they end up challenging each other to a contest of romance in order to determine what form their relationship will take.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
